MAC_SOURCE="import hashlib,json,os,subprocess,sys,tarfile
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd();work=Path(os.environ['HALO2_TEST_SCRATCH'])
report={'schema':'H2_MACOS_STEAM_RUNTIME_CHECK_V1','scratch':str(work),'runs':[],'retained_large_artifacts':[]}
def digest(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
try:
 with tarfile.open(fileobj=sys.stdin.buffer,mode='r|gz') as archive:archive.extractall(work,filter='data')
 sdk=work/'sdk';relocated=work/'Relocated Steam runtime Ω';sdk.rename(relocated)
 sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'tools/macos'))
 from verify_steam_sdk import verify
 report['audit']=verify(relocated,sign=True)
 report['signed_manifest']=json.loads((relocated/'manifest.json').read_text())
 before={str(p.relative_to(relocated)):digest(p) for p in relocated.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
 env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith(('DYLD_','DOTNET_','OPENSSL_','SSL_'))}
 env.update(PATH='/usr/bin:/bin',DOTNET_ROOT='/missing-host-dotnet',DOTNET_MULTILEVEL_LOOKUP='0',DOTNET_EnableDiagnostics='0',DOTNET_CLI_HOME=str(work/'dotnet-user'))
 for arch,cpu in [('arm64','Arm64'),('x86_64','X64')]:
  row={'arch':arch};report['runs'].append(row)
  binary=relocated/arch/'Halo2Steam'
  command=['/usr/bin/arch','-'+arch,str(binary),'runtime-info']
  r=subprocess.run(command,env=env,cwd=work,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=25)
  row['runtime']={'command':list(command),'exit_code':r.returncode,'stderr':r.stderr[-3000:]}
  if r.returncode:raise RuntimeError('Steam runtime info failed on '+arch)
  info=json.loads(r.stdout);row['runtime']['result']=info
  assert info['architecture']==cpu and info['framework']=='.NET 10.0.12',info
  assert info['sha256_abc']=='BA7816BF8F01CFEA414140DE5DAE2223B00361A396177A9CB410FF61F20015AD'
  assert Path(info['core_library']).resolve().is_relative_to(relocated/arch)
  for image in info['images']:
   assert image.startswith(('/System/Library/','/usr/lib/')) or Path(image).resolve().is_relative_to(relocated/arch),image
  command[-1]='app-info'
  r=subprocess.run(command,env=env,cwd=work,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=80)
  row['appinfo']={'command':list(command),'exit_code':r.returncode,'stderr':r.stderr[-3000:]}
  if r.returncode:raise RuntimeError('Real Steam metadata request failed on '+arch)
  data=json.loads(r.stdout);row['appinfo']['result']=data
  sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'tools'))
  from steam_content import depot_plan
  row['depot_plan']=depot_plan(data)
  assert data['anonymous'] is True
 assert before=={str(p.relative_to(relocated)):digest(p) for p in relocated.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
 report.update(passed=True,unchanged_sdk=True)
except BaseException as error:
 report.update(passed=False,error_class=type(error).__name__,error=str(error)[:5000])
finally:
 print(json.dumps(report),flush=True)
sys.exit(0 if report.get('passed') else 1)

import hashlib,json,os,shlex,subprocess,sys,tarfile
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd();work=Path(os.environ['HALO2_TEST_SCRATCH'])
out=root/'build/test-results/macos-steam-sdk-portable';out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
command=[sys.executable,'-B','tools/macos/build_steam.py','--work',str(work/'work'),'--prefix',str(work/'sdk'),'--arch','arm64','--arch','x86_64']
report={'schema':'H2_MACOS_STEAM_BUILD_CHECK_V1','scratch':str(work),'command':command,'mac_test_source':MAC_SOURCE}
try:
 with (out/'build.log').open('w') as log:result=subprocess.run(command,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
 report['build_exit']=result.returncode
 if result.returncode:raise RuntimeError('Steam helper SDK build failed')
 (out/'manifest.json').write_bytes((work/'sdk/manifest.json').read_bytes())
 (out/'packages.lock.json').write_bytes((work/'work/project/packages.lock.json').read_bytes())
 report['nuget_archive_sha256']={str(p.relative_to(work/'work/nuget')):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in (work/'work/nuget').rglob('*.nupkg')}
 archive=work/'sdk.tar.gz'
 with tarfile.open(archive,'w:gz') as stream:stream.add(work/'sdk',arcname='sdk')
 remote='cd /Users/eric/Developer/Halo2-macos-port && export PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH && '+shlex.join(['python3','-B','tools/run_test.py','--scratch-root','.local/test-scratch','--','python3','-B','-c',MAC_SOURCE])
 with archive.open('rb') as data:result=subprocess.run(['ssh','-o','BatchMode=yes','-o','ConnectTimeout=15','codex-mac',remote],stdin=data,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True,timeout=300)
 report['mac_exit']=result.returncode
 report['mac_stderr']=result.stderr[-4000:]
 try:report['mac']=json.loads(result.stdout)
 except ValueError:report['malformed_stdout']=result.stdout[-3000:]
 report['passed']=result.returncode==0 and report.get('mac',{}).get('passed',False)
except BaseException as error:
 report.update(passed=False,error=str(error))
finally:
 (out/'report.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'
')
 print(json.dumps({'passed':report.get('passed'),'error':report.get('error'),'mac_error':report.get('mac',{}).get('error'),'build_tail':(out/'build.log').read_text(errors='replace')[-2500:] if report.get('build_exit') else None,'mac_runs':[{k:v for k,v in r.items() if k=='arch'} for r in report.get('mac',{}).get('runs',[])]}))
sys.exit(0 if report.get('passed') else 1)
